angle.line: Sloping off the ceiling at an angle
angle.linePrev: I hear the sound escaping as an echo
angle.lineNext: And when the voices blend they sound like angels

angle.line: To let me dangle at a cruel angle
stanza: To let me dangle at a cruel angle
Oh, my feet don't touch the floor
Sometimes you're half in and then you're half out
But you never close the door

angle.line: Gotta hit the club like you hit them mothafuckin' angles
angle.linePrev: Gotta hit the club, gotta make that ass jump
angle.lineNext: With your phone out, snappin' like you Fabo

dangle.line: Spiders’ ghosts hang, soaked and dangling
stanza: I see the blossoms broke and wet after the rain
Little sister, he will be back again
I have washed a thousand spiders down the drain
Spiders’ ghosts hang, soaked and dangling
Silently from all the blooming cherry trees
In tiny nooses, safe from everyone —
Nothing but a nuisance; gone now, dead and done —
Be a woman. Be a woman

dangle.line: Midnight, you could see me dangling
stanza: Midnight, you could see me dangling
Glow like a cherry falling, now it's a downpour
You could see me racing the rain to the ground floor
You're the only thing I'll wait around for
Maybe when you get off of work, could you meet me?
We could go barreling down on the main street
You could try watching while I run through the high-beams
I wait at the table and hold hands with weeping strangers
Wait for you to join the group
The tambourine jingle-jangles
The medium
Roams and rambles
Not taken in,
I break the circle
I want this man to go away now

tangle.songTitle: Let’s Not Shit Ourselves (To Love and to Be Loved)
tangle.line: Well, I awoke in relief, my sheets and tubes were all tangled
stanza: Well, I awoke in relief, my sheets and tubes were all tangled
Weak from whiskey and pills in a Chicago hospital
And my father was there, in a chair by the window
Staring so far away
I tried talking, just whispered, "So sorry, so selfish"
He stopped me and said, "Child, I love you regardless
And there's nothing you could do that would ever change this
I'm not angry, it happens
But you just can't do it again"

tangle.line: This love triangle left us in a wreck, tangled
stanza: Always the bridesmaid, never "The bride, hey!"
Fuck can I say? If life was a highway
And deceit was an enclave, I'd be swervin' in five lanes
Speeds at a high rate, like I'm slidin' on ice, maybe
That's why I may have came at you sideways
I can't keep my lies straight
But I made you terminate my baby
This love triangle left us in a wreck, tangled
What else can I say? It was fun for a while
Bet I really woulda loved your smile
Didn't really wanna abort, but fuck it
What's one more lie, to tell our unborn child?
Seaweed tangled
In our home from home
Reminds me of
Your rocky bottom
